parts.text: The masses, in grams, of large bags of sugar and small bags of sugar are denoted by $X$ and $Y$ respectively, where $X \sim \text{N}(5.1, 0.2^2)$ and $Y \sim \text{N}(2.5, 0.1^2)$. Find the probability that the mass of a randomly chosen large bag is less than twice the mass of a randomly chosen small bag.
